scoring_justification: Recompute complete-disintegration thresholds and dominant decay modes from raw quench events; no self-reported metric needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Complete-disintegration thresholds and required dominant decay modes
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: B* thresholds from Fig.4 as stated in text; decay modes from section describing Figs.4 and 5.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numbers and decay mode descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the paper's own reported quantities; not invented.

outputs.description: Raw quench events; each element contains the cluster size, the quenched attraction strength, and the fragmentation outcomes for all independent quench runs. The verifier recomputes the complete-disintegration threshold (where average multiplicity equals N) and dominant decay modes from these raw data.

output_contract.notes: The agent must produce all required quench events for N=5,12,15. The verifier will recompute thresholds and modes T1-style. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed.

steps.description: Recompute complete-disintegration thresholds (B* where average multiplicity equals N) and verify dominant decay modes for N=5,12,15 from the raw quench events.
